subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu group chat: slash commands like /new, /status, and /model do not work and may lose message content

question: Should remaining Feishu text slash commands be authorized through a Feishu-scoped structured CommandTurn and admitted-sender contract, or by changing the shared command-gating default for all unconfigured access-group authorizers?
rationale: Current source proves the bug, but the two plausible fix shapes have different security and compatibility blast radius across channel command authorization.

options.title: Prefer Feishu-Scoped Structured Command Turns
options.body: Authorize Feishu text commands for already-admitted Feishu senders when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, attach explicit text command-turn metadata, and preserve denial when explicit command allowlists reject the sender.

options.title: Approve Shared Gate Change
options.body: Change `resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers` so all-unconfigured access-group authorizers are allowed, but require cross-channel security and upgrade tests before merge.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Command Defaults
options.body: Require explicit command allowlists for Feishu control commands and update docs/diagnostics so operators understand the configuration requirement.

recommendation.title: Prefer Feishu-Scoped Structured Command Turns
recommendation.body: Authorize Feishu text commands for already-admitted Feishu senders when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, attach explicit text command-turn metadata, and preserve denial when explicit command allowlists reject the sender.

likelyOwner.reason: The related maintainer comment already routed the remaining stateful Feishu command problem to an owner-approved structured command-turn and authorization design.
